text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day. It started raining on my way 
out, so I decided to do some shopping to 
pass the time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And by the time the rain stopped—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo, hoo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Yahoo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer suddenly came running over, 
drenched in her racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this outfit? Don't worry, it's fine! 
It'll dry off while I'm running anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, that doesn't really explain 
anything, does it? Um, you see—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a wry smile, Mejiro Palmer told me 
how it all happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how all of us Mejiros ended 
up getting dragged to this stuffy party~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They told me, "We've prepared a car for 
your return," so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't take it anymore. I told 
everyone 'Sorry!' and made a run for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smiling back at a thought so typical of 
her, I still couldn't help but worry about 
her racing silks. After all, they were 
completely drenched in the rain...
choice_data_list:
Are you sure about leaving your racing 
outfit...?

Are you sure about leaving your racing 
outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, well, it makes sense you'd think 
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't really mind, though. I ordered it 
with that in mind anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it, this design isn't 
really all that different from my casual 
clothes, right?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"So there's no need to put on airs. It's 
easy to run, and easy to run away."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Above all, if I ever feel like running on 
my own, I can just dash right out in a 
flash!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The word "alone" felt a bit unnatural. I 
feel like she's usually with someone. When 
I asked her about it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I like being with everyone. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Only one person can take the lead in a 
race, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why sometimes I just feel 
like running off without thinking about 
anything at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Toward the horizon, freely, endlessly, all 
on my own, no matter how far!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes look far into the distance. 
Surely, in that place, no restrictions or 
constraints exist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, a little while later—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's falling again...!
choice_data_list:
Want to grab some tea while we take 
shelter from the rain?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if we run we won't get soaked too 
badly! Let's hurry—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the umbrella and held it over her 
head. Since there's only one, it might be 
a bit of a tight squeeze, though.
choice_data_list:
I just don't want you to catch a cold, you 
know.

I just don't want you to catch a cold, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Look at you being so mature, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nice, maybe I'll try doing that to someone 
next time. Just like you did, Trainer—like 
*swish*!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wellll... I don't know if I can do it that 
well, but still! Aha, you really are an 
adult, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! I'm all for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Here, hot coffee for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite wearing her racing silks, Mejiro 
Palmer looks completely natural, blending 
right into the atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking how wonderful your 
racing outfit looks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is it, why so formal!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Geez, your coffee's gonna get cold while 
you're talking! Here, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, I chatted and 
laughed with Mejiro Palmer.
